**Coaching note:**

Your knight on c2 checks the king AND simultaneously attacks both b5 and f5 pawns—a classic fork! When your opponent moves the king to escape check, you capture one of the undefended pawns. Always scan for checks that hit multiple targets; they often win material. In tactical positions, move-order matters: find forcing moves first.
